name: Jack
source:
A former blacksmith for the Ventali Army, Jack has abandoned his practice and moved to the eastern side of the continent, selling goods and running his own trading business. He’s a fairly nice person and will avoid all fights as best as he can.

[From the [url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]official website[/url]]
